Earlier scenes:
(none)

This scene:
孟子小的时候，从早到晚都跟朋友玩。孟子和他的朋友喜欢玩在墓地里，装祭拜。孟子五岁的时候，跟妈妈搬家。他们搬家不是因为孟子玩得太多，而是因为妈妈认为他们的家离墓地太近。

The teacher's corrections on this scene (student words：her correction, her note):
- 孟子小的时候：better to briefly introduce “孟子” when this character first appears
- 孟子和他的朋友喜欢玩在墓地里，装祭拜：在墓地玩，在Place V.; 装着祭拜的样子

The system's feedback items:
1. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 喜欢玩在墓地里：喜欢在墓地里玩，The place phrase should come before the main verb in this sentence. [rule: none]
2. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 装祭拜：装作祭拜，装作 means “pretend to do something”; 装 cannot directly take this verb phrase here. [rule: none]
3. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 跟妈妈搬家：妈妈带着他搬家，The mother is the person who takes the child to move; 带着孟子搬家 expresses this relationship more accurately. [vocab list]
4. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 孟子小的时候：有一个小男孩叫孟子，他小时候，At a character’s first mention, introduce the character with a full noun phrase; later reference to the same character can use a pronoun. [rule: character_introduction_first_mention]
5. [Coherence: temporality, error] Coherence (Temporality): 搬家：搬家了，This move is presented as a completed event, so the final verb needs 了. [rule: aspect_le_completed]

items.reason: 地点短语应放在动词“玩”前面。
“装”不能直接带“祭拜”这个动词短语，“装作祭拜”可以表示假装在祭拜。
“跟妈妈搬家”自然且正确，并不需要改成妈妈带着他搬家。
首次出现孟子需要作人物介绍，但给出的改文“他小时候，”是不完整的。
这里叙述的是已经完成的搬家事件，应用“搬家了”。
